title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Mohana grows emotional when Sethupathi calls him his mother, while Tamizhselvi rejects Vellathai's plea to reunite. A remorseful Aishwarya walks out to accept her punishment.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Saranya denies knowing of the affair and stands firm against throwing Pooja out. While Kasthuri and Karthik defend the couple, Kamala fuels Karikalan's anger to oust Pooja.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Senthil gets angry when Rajeshwari decides to sell her farmhouse to clear her debts on Vennila's suggestion. Rajasekar makes plans for Pavithra and Kanmani's bangle ceremony.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Azhagappan makes Kandhasamy bear the cost of reception banners, putting him in trouble. Indhira is overjoyed when Murugan names their catering service after her.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: After the feast, both families happily bond as they share their joys and sorrows. However, Sakthivel triggers a dispute by recalling the past incident, disrupting the peace.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Devika offers Manoj financial support after learning about the showroom theft. Shruthi gives back the money her parents provide for her needs following their insult.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Senthamizh defies Manjamalai's orders to meet the groom and elopes with Thennavan. Meanwhile, a shocked Poongodi learns Senthamizh is missing after looking for her at college.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma tricks Rishi into stopping Ilamathi from getting Viji's blood for the DNA test to win the challenge. While, Ilamathi promises Paraman proof of his real mother.
